Installation Guide

This guide provides detailed instructions for installing and setting up the NIST SP 800-22 Randomness Test Tool.

Prerequisites

Before installing the application, ensure you have the following prerequisites:

  • Python 3.8 or higher

  • Redis server

  • Nginx web server (recommended)

  • NIST SP 800-22 test suite implementation

System Requirements

  • Linux/Unix operating system

  • At least 2GB of RAM

  • Sufficient disk space for storing test files and results

  • Internet connection for downloading dependencies

Installation Steps

1. Clone the Repository

git clone <repository-url>
cd rtt

2. Install Python Dependencies

pip install -r requirements.txt

3. Configure Redis

Install Redis if not already installed:

sudo apt-get install redis-server

Start Redis service:

sudo systemctl start redis-server
sudo systemctl enable redis-server

4. Configure Nginx

Install Nginx:

sudo apt-get install nginx

Create Nginx configuration file:

server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name your_domain.com;

    ssl_certificate /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    location /static {
        alias /path/to/web_app/static;
    }
}

5. Set Up Application Directory

Create necessary directories:

sudo mkdir -p /tmp/rtt
sudo chown -R $USER:$USER /tmp/rtt

6. Configure Application

Set up environment variables:

export FLASK_APP=web_app/app.py
export FLASK_ENV=production
export SECRET_KEY=your_secret_key

7. Start the Application

Using Gunicorn:

gunicorn -w 4 -b 127.0.0.1:8000 web_app.app:app

Verification

To verify the installation:

  1. Access the web interface at https://your_domain.com

  2. Try uploading a sample binary file

  3. Run a basic test

  4. Check if results are generated correctly

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  1. Redis Connection Error - Ensure Redis is running: sudo systemctl status redis-server - Check Redis configuration: redis-cli ping

  2. Permission Issues - Verify directory permissions: ls -la /tmp/rtt - Check file ownership: sudo chown -R $USER:$USER /tmp/rtt

  3. Nginx Configuration - Test Nginx configuration: sudo nginx -t - Check Nginx logs: sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log

  4. Application Logs - Check application logs for errors - Verify environment variables are set correctly

Getting Help

If you encounter issues:

  1. Check the application logs

  2. Review the Nginx error logs

  3. Verify Redis connection

  4. Ensure all dependencies are installed correctly

  5. Check file permissions and ownership
